reason: The star punch and black card disc are the obvious pieces for making a starry sky.
expectation: The punch should make star holes in the disc.

effect: The disc now has its star pattern, so I can assemble the box around it.
reason: The reflective lining belongs inside the theatre box before the other components are fitted.
expectation: The box will gain a reflective interior.

effect: The lining is installed and should direct more light toward the star disc while avoiding the contacts.
reaction: The explanation of the lining’s purpose was useful.
reason: The disc needs a spindle to turn, so I’ll try fitting it to the box.
expectation: The box will gain a spindle for the star disc.

effect: The spindle fits the star disc first, making a shadow wheel rather than attaching directly to the box.
reaction: The compatibility feedback resolved my wrong guess.
reason: The lamp module and its battery pack seem like the next pieces needed to illuminate the star wheel.
expectation: The battery pack will connect to the lamp module.

effect: The lamp installs in the box before connecting to its battery pack.
reaction: The automatic compatibility feedback corrected another wrong guess.
reason: The installed lamp needs power, so I’ll try attaching the battery pack to the theatre.
expectation: The battery pack will be fitted to the theatre’s lamp.

effect: The battery pack joins the switched lead first, making a supply for the installed lamp.
reaction: The feedback corrected another mistaken assembly order.
reason: The switched supply should now connect to the theatre’s lamp.
expectation: The lamp will be connected to its switched battery supply.

effect: The switched battery supply is connected, leaving the shadow wheel to fit into the powered theatre.
reaction: The lamp assembly is now in place.
reason: The shadow wheel needs to sit in the theatre so its star holes can be illuminated and turned.
expectation: The shadow wheel will fit into the theatre.

effect: The shadow wheel is installed between the lamp and opening, completing the goal and showing how turning it moves the patches of light.
reaction: The explanation made the finished arrangement clearer.

mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the shadow wheel was most worthwhile: it brought the parts together and explained how the moving star patches are made.

leastWorthwhile.text: The repeated wrong guesses about assembly order became a little repetitive, although the compatibility feedback kept things moving.

surprise.text: I expected the spindle to attach to the box first, but it joined the star disc to make a shadow wheel.

arbitrary.text: Some assembly ordering was hard to predict, particularly whether the battery pack should connect to the lamp or the switched lead first.

continue.text: I would be curious to continue: seeing how the star shadows look in practice could build on the explanation, though I would hope for fewer opaque assembly-order choices.
